claims.text: The hotel is a short walk from the Apgujeong and Cheongdam neighborhoods, with Korean luxury fashion and beauty, art museums and dining.

findings.quote: is just a short walk from the affluent Apgujeong and Cheongdam neighborhoods where you can explore Korean-chic luxury fashion and beauty, art museums and culinary delights

claims.text: The hotel's interiors are filled with original art and have views of Gangnam.

findings.quote: interiors filled with original art and views of Gangnam

claims.text: Standard King rooms have a diagonal wall that subtly divides the space.

findings.quote: Escape to this comfortable room with one king bed featuring glamorous views of Gangnam. The unique interior design includes a striking diagonal wall that subtly divides the space

claims.text: Rooms include a complimentary minibar with snacks, non-alcoholic beverages and beer.

findings.quote: Complimentary minibar with snacks, non-alcoholic beverages, and beer

claims.text: Rooms have Byredo bath amenities.

findings.quote: Byredo bath amenities

claims.text: Premium rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and a bathroom with a deep soaking tub and rain shower, and can be converted into a family room.

findings.quote: Our largest standard room features floor-to-ceiling windows, exciting views of Seoul, a plush king bed, and a spacious bathroom with a deep soaking tub and rain shower. This room can also be converted into a family room.

claims.text: The Sky Terrace Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows, a private terrace and a dining area with a bar.

findings.quote: a spacious interior featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, a separate living area, private terrace, a dining area boasting a bar

claims.text: The Garden Suite is on the 3rd floor, with garden views and a multimedia experience in the living area.

findings.quote: this 3rd floor suite boasts refreshing garden views, floor-to-ceiling windows, a dynamic multi-media experience in the living area

claims.text: The Summer House includes an indoor pool and fitness center.

findings.quote: Complimentary access to The Summer House (indoor Pool & fitness center)

claims.text: The hotel's spa is Ocelas Spa, part of The Summer House.

findings.quote: Ocelas Spa \| The Summer House

claims.text: Meat & Co. Steakhouse grills local Hanwoo and American beef in a Pira charcoal oven.

findings.quote: premium cuts of local Hanwoo and American beef skillfully grilled to perfection in the original Pira charcoal oven

claims.text: Room service is available 24 hours.

findings.quote: Our 24-hour private dining service brings you exquisite meals prepared by our professional chefs

claims.text: Guestroom interiors, artwork and amenities are inspired by Bojagi, the traditional Korean patchwork weaving art.

findings.quote: Inspired by the meaningful Bojagi, traditional Korean patchwork weaving art, the creative interiors, artwork and amenities in guestrooms

claims.text: The hotel is directly connected to Apgujeong Metro Station in Seoul.

findings.quote: Andaz Seoul Gangnam is directly connected to the Apgujeong Metro Station in Seoul

claims.text: The Gangnam Penthouse has a theater sound system, a circular deep soaking tub overlooking the Han River and Seoul, and an expansive outdoor terrace.

findings.quote: The spacious suite features an impressive theater sound system in the living area
a luxurious bathroom with a rain shower and circular deep soaking tub overlooking the Han River and Seoul, a dining area and an expansive outdoor terrace ideal for entertaining

findings.quote: located on a high floor (10th floor and above) and featuring glamorous, unobstructed views of Gangnam

findings.quote: Jogakbo was inspired by Apgujeong Gourmet Alley, comprising three unique interactive dining zones: Bites & Wine, Jogakbo Kitchen, and Meat & Co. Steakhouse.

Escape to this peaceful room with two twin beds featuring exciting views of Gangnam
